detail.longDescription:
I have some legacy HTML code (actually created by a Python script) that I am maintaining that prompts the user to enter various fields in a table. Then, upon Submit, those fields are written to a MongoDB database. One of the fields is a file name. The file name entry field uses an input type="file" . When the data (file name) is pulled from the form, the file starts uploading. I don't need the file, just the file name. Some of the files selected are many gigabytes long and with a slow server connection, cause the page to hang for several minutes until finished. How do I prompt for a file without automatically uploading it? Note: I would rather not rewrite the Python script to use more modern widgets as that would take more time than I am allocated.
